content:
[Intro]
[E]

[Verse 1]
[E]I was a sailor, I was
lost at sea I was
under the waves before love
rescued me
I was a fighter, I could
turn on a thread Now
I stand accused of the
things I've said When love

[Chorus]
[A]comes to town I'm gonna
jump that train When love
[E]comes to town I'm gonna
catch that flame
Maybe I was wrong to ever
let you down But I
did what I did before love
came to town

[Break]
[E]

[Verse 2]
[E]Used to make love under a red
sunset I was
making promises I was
soon to forget She was
pale as the lace of her
wedding gown But I
left her standing before love
came to town

[Verse 3]
[A]I ran into a jukejoint when I heard
a guitar scream The
[E]notes were turning blue, I was
dazed and in a dream As the
music played I saw my
life turn around
That was the day before love
came to town When love

[Chorus]
[A]comes to town I'm gonna
jump that train When love
[E]comes to town I'm gonna
catch that flame
Maybe I was wrong to ever
let you down But I
did what I did before love
came to town

[Break]
[E]
When love

[Chorus]
[A]comes to town I'm gonna
jump that train When love
[E]comes to town I'm gonna
catch that flame
Maybe I was wrong to ever
let you down But I
did what I did before love
came to town

[Solo]
[E]

[Verse 4]
[E]I was there when they cru-
cified my Lord
I held the scabbard when the sol-
dier drew his sword
I threw the dice when they
pierced his side But I've
seen love conquer the
great divide When love

[Chorus]
[A]comes to town I'm gonna
catch that train When love
[E]comes to town I'm gonna
catch that flame
Maybe I was wrong to ever
let you down But I
did what I did before love
came to town

[Outro]
[E]
[A]
[E]
[A]
[E]
[A]

[E]

title: When Love Comes To Town
tuning: E A D G B E
